changeSet.sql: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS public.ranked_tenant CASCADE; CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.ranked_tenant AS SELECT t.id AS tid, t.last_update_date, lo.operator_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY t.last_update_date) AS rank FROM tenant t LEFT JOIN latest_operator lo ON t.id = lo.tenant_id WHERE t.status::text = 'TO_PROCESS'::text AND t.honor_declaration = true AND (t.ready_for_auto_validation = false OR t.ready_for_auto_validation IS NULL) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document d WHERE d.tenant_id = t.id AND d.watermark_file_id IS NULL)) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guarantor g JOIN document d2 ON g.id = d2.guarantor_id WHERE g.tenant_id = t.id AND d2.watermark_file_id IS NULL)) WITH NO DATA;

rollback.sql: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS public.ranked_tenant CASCADE; CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.ranked_tenant AS SELECT t.id AS tid, t.last_update_date, lo.operator_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY t.last_update_date) AS rank FROM tenant t LEFT JOIN latest_operator lo ON t.id = lo.tenant_id WHERE t.status::text = 'TO_PROCESS'::text AND t.honor_declaration = true AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document d WHERE d.tenant_id = t.id AND d.watermark_file_id IS NULL)) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guarantor g JOIN document d2 ON g.id = d2.guarantor_id WHERE g.tenant_id = t.id AND d2.watermark_file_id IS NULL)) WITH NO DATA; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ranked_tenant_tid ON public.ranked_tenant (tid);
